sources.fact: Current authoritative Brownfield entity is LBBD 84/HZ, Hertford Road Industrial Estate.
The record starts and enters on 31 December 2024 and has no end date.
Current minimum and maximum net dwellings are both 957 on 8.2 hectares.
Ownership-status is not-owned-by-a-public-authority; this is a category, not a named proprietor or title relation.
The record supplies a point and blank geometry, not an application or HMLR polygon.
Regulation 19 HTML retains HZ as a Local Plan site-allocation attachment; plan publication is not site permission.
LBBD states the Local Plan 2037 was adopted on 18 September 2024.
Development Plan policy is used to assess applications and does not itself grant HZ permission.
The September 2025 Wickes/HA application is an adjacent separate site; its amended 850-unit proposal is not transferred to HZ.
LBBD states Brownfield Register sites still require planning permission.
No exact current 957-home HZ application/issued decision or complete title topology was verified this wave.

examples.result: HZ remains a current 957-home Brownfield capacity record.
The 8.2-hectare allocation is not converted from a point into a legal parcel polygon.
Adjacent Wickes/HA units are not added to HZ.
Local Plan adoption is not a planning permission.
Private/non-public ownership category is not a named owner or title.
No exact current HZ residential application is guessed from allocation status.
Promotion remains zero until exact current case, title relations and executed overlays are verified.
